name: google-people
description: Google People integration — contacts, profiles and domain directory via official Google MCP server (https://people.googleapis.com/mcp/v1, OAuth2).

auth.label: Connect with Google
auth.hint: Authorizes via Google's OAuth 2.0 flow. Google does not support dynamic client registration for this scope -- create an OAuth client (type "Desktop app") in Google Cloud Console and paste its ID/secret below.

fields.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
fields.label: Google OAuth Client ID
fields.hint: Google Cloud Console -> APIs & Services -> Credentials. Use an OAuth client of type "Desktop app".
